paragraphs: R' Yosi, son of R' Dosa.
Mentioned in Bereshit Rabbah, chapter 66, and Vayikra Rabbah 14:5; he says that Eliezer is Canaan.[^1][^2]

notes.text: ב"ר פ"סו and ויק"ר פ"יד-ה are read as Bereshit Rabbah chapter 66 and Vayikra Rabbah chapter 14 section 5. The he is retained as locator numeral, not dropped into the verb. Neither locus or numbering is independently checked against a named edition.

The heading figure is the understood subject of says; Eliezer-is-Canaan remains the source’s assertion, without independently verifying the attribution or binding identities. Both title abbreviations remain R'.
